pages.text: Moon's Whatsits also has a few proper prepared foods rather than just ingredients and snacks.$(br2)These recipes use familiar ingredients and turn them into something a bit more substantial.

pages.title: Meals
pages.text: The meals currently added are Avocado Toast, Scrambled Eggs and Sunny Side Eggs.

pages.title: Sunny Side Eggs
pages.text: Sunny Side Eggs are made using a Farmer's Delight Skillet.$(br2)First, throw a normal Egg to get an Egg Yolk. Place a Skillet on a lit Stove, then right-click the Skillet with the Egg Yolk.$(br2)After cooking, the Egg Yolk becomes Sunny Side Eggs.
Avocado Toast, Scrambled Eggs and Sunny Side Eggs all have their recipes available in the recipe viewer.
